set.body: Acceptance criteria: median and Savitzky-Golay emit the first half-width samples unchanged, filtered centres once, and the final half-width samples unchanged; output timestamps equal input timestamps exactly; output cardinality is unchanged; half-width and regular-sampling requirements fail at construction with operand-rich errors; missing and off-screen window policy is explicit; pupil and sample origin are preserved or explicitly invalidated; smoothed positions outside the frame become off-screen; sequence laws publish from eyes4s-laws and reject a duplicate-tail mutant.
set.title: Repair centred filters and publish sample-sequence laws
